Priya (People Ops): hey @Samir quick one — new hire Evan started remote last week but his onboarding address is showing CT while his legal residence is MA. payroll-bot also flagged a state withholding mismatch :thinking_face:
Evan Tran (New Hire): yup that was me — I updated my address in the portal after I accepted, but maybe I missed the state tax form step? i filled federal W-4 but not the MA form yet
Samir (Payroll): thanks — payroll-bot note: payrun 2026-03-20 processed for Evan (ID 7842) with CT withholding. we need to decide: retro active fix for this payrun or correct next cycle + benefits effective date check.
Priya (People Ops): manager @ben is okay with an off-cycle fix if it's straightforward. Evan, did you submit any state withholding form (CT-W4 or MA M-4)?
Evan Tran (New Hire): I only saw the generic state form link and thought it autofilled based on address. i don't remember completing CT or MA specific forms. i can complete MA M-4 now.
Jules (Hiring Ops): note for audit — candidate offer had MA as primary residence. we should reconcile docs in Lever/Greenhouse. i'll attach the offer pdf to the HR folder after this thread.
Samir (Payroll): ok steps from payroll side:
1) Evan needs to complete MA withholding (M-4) and upload to ADP.
2) We can run an off-cycle adjustment to reclassify state withholding from CT -> MA for payrun 7842. that will generate a supplemental payment or refund depending on amounts.
3) If MA withholding is higher, employee might owe; if lower, we issue refund. we'll confirm amounts after forms.
Priya (People Ops): can you estimate the turnaround time? this is first paycheck for Evan (probation pay). manager wants to avoid pay surprises.
Samir (Payroll): estimate: once forms are in ADP, we can queue off-cycle within 2 business days. tax team will estimate delta same day. if it's under $200 we usually handle via single refund; over that we do a check run and notify employee.
Evan Tran (New Hire): thanks — i'll fill the MA M-4 tonight. any specific fields i should watch for?
Samir (Payroll): select "Resident" and use your MA address. if you have multiple residences in the year (say moving mid-month) note that in comments. also set allowances per your W-4 unless you want different. if you want us to mirror federal, say so.
Priya (People Ops): @payroll-bot any automated reminders we can trigger for new hires who haven't completed state forms?
payroll-bot: automated reminder scheduled. Next reminder in 24h to Evan. Link: https://adp.example.company/forms/7842
ben (Manager): Evan — pls ping me if this affects your net pay, happy to coordinate with People Ops to advance a small emergency reimbursement if needed.
Evan Tran (New Hire): appreciate it, @ben. i submitted the MA M-4 just now (confirmed upload). receipt: M4-evan-2026-03-22.pdf
Samir (Payroll): got it. i'll review and run estimate. provisional calc: CT withheld $45, expected MA withholding $58 -> net delta ~$13 withheld more in MA. looks like refund not needed (MA higher) but payroll will reclassify so state taxes map correctly on paystub and year-end.
Priya (People Ops): great — can you update the payrun notes with reclassification and mark resolved once processed? we'll need this for the new hire audit.
Samir (Payroll): will do. recorded note: "Reclassified state withholding for Evan Tran, payrun 7842, CT -> MA; forms received 2026-03-22."
Jules (Hiring Ops): tagging for audit trail. i'll move offer + ID docs into the secure HR folder: /hr/onboarding/evan_tran_2026/
Evan Tran (New Hire): one more Q — does this affect benefits eligibility dates? my benefits start date in Workday shows 2026-04-01.
Priya (People Ops): benefits effective date stays the same (based on start date & plan rules). payroll will just correct the tax mapping.
Samir (Payroll): confirmed. no change to benefits. i'll post when off-cycle is executed.
Samir (Payroll): off-cycle processed 2026-03-23 09:12 UTC. refund/adjustment: none required (MA withheld slightly more). paystub updated and ADP notes attached.
Priya (People Ops): thanks team — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
